_note: REAL (not synthetic) pre-refresh fixture: the ledger rows (origin/web/f391~1 lib/ledger.json, estate_ey 60.6, kernel export of 2026-10-09). Used to prove the ported formulas reproduce the exporter's own output.

estate_ey.method: Basic COCOMO organic 2.4*KSLOC^1.05 person-months / 12 on 230.8 KSLOC

span_days.method: union of days with a non-bot commit in any repo, 2026-05-04 to 2026-10-08

compute_build_aud_month.method: about US$30 a month of AI tools while the main engine was built (to 29 September); no receipt on file

compute_today_aud_month.method: AU$300 a month of AI tools since 29 September; no receipt on file

model_schedule_months.method: Basic COCOMO organic: effort = 2.4 x KSLOC^1.05 person-months, schedule = 2.5 x effort^0.38 months

elapsed_months.method: 158 days from the first commit (4 May 2026) / 30.4375

build_cost_aud.method: 60.6 engineer-years x AU$800 a day x 220 working days = AU$176,000 per engineer-year

per_dollar_build_x.method: 10% annual value / (AU$46 x 12) on the build spend

per_dollar_today_x.method: 10% annual value / (AU$300 x 12) at today's spend

rate_note: AU$800 a day x 220 working days = AU$176,000 per engineer-year
